name: Social Security Fund (กองทุนประกันสังคม)

references.title: Social Security Act B.E. 2533 (1990) ss.33, 46, 47; Ministerial Regulation on the s.33 wage base B.E. 2568
references.locator: SSA ss.33, 46, 47; MR B.E. 2568 (1 January 2029 to 31 December 2031)
references.quote: Employee and employer each contribute 5 percent of the insured wage; insured wage base 1,650-20,000 baht a month from 1 January 2029 to 31 December 2031.

name: Workmen's Compensation Fund (กองทุนเงินทดแทน)

references.title: Workmen's Compensation Act B.E. 2537 (1994) ss.5, 44-45; Ministry of Labour notification of 21 February 2019, Table 1
references.url: https://www.mol.go.th/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2021/02/6-ประกาศกระทรวงแรงงาน-เรื่อง-ประเภท-ขนาดของกิจการ-ท้องที่ที่ให้นายจ้างจ่ายเงินสมทบฯ.pdf
references.quote: 1,091 business codes at 0.20-1.00 percent of wages; annual wage ceiling 240,000 baht a person; the annual assessment rounds to the whole baht, while the payroll line accrues at currency precision.

name: Provident fund (กองทุนสำรองเลี้ยงชีพ)

references.title: Provident Fund Act B.E. 2530 (1987) s.10 (as amended by Act No. 4 B.E. 2558)
references.quote: Employee and employer each contribute 2-15 percent of wages at the rates in the registered fund rules; higher rates need ministerial approval.

references.title: Provident Fund Act B.E. 2530 (1987) s.3 definition of wages
references.quote: "wages" means money an employer gives an employee in return for work, however specified, calculated or paid, but excludes overtime, holiday pay, and money or other gains the employer withholds or pays in addition for the benefit of the work.

name: Personal income tax withholding (ภ.ง.ด.1)

references.title: Revenue Code ss.40(1), 42 bis, 47, 48, 50(1); Revenue Department Instruction P.96/2543
references.quote: Progressive rates 0-35 percent; expense 50 percent up to 100,000 baht; personal allowance 60,000 baht; withholding is projected from actual and remaining income and prior tax.

references.title: Revenue Department Order Por.96/2543 on withholding under s.50(1)
references.quote: Regular pay is annualised over the payments actually due in the year; the tax a bonus or overtime adds is withheld whole in the month it is paid; in the last month of work the payer may recompute on actual deductions.

references.title: Revenue Department, allowances and deductions; Form PND91 instructions, tax year 2024
references.locator: items on the provident fund, social security and the combined limit
references.quote: Social security contributions as paid; provident fund savings to 15 percent of wages, the first 10,000 baht a deduction and the rest to 490,000 baht exempt, within the 500,000 baht limit shared with pension insurance. Employee Welfare Fund savings are not a listed relief.

references.title: Revenue Code s.47(3)
references.quote: A taxpayer not resident in Thailand deducts the spouse and child allowances only for a spouse and children in Thailand.

references.title: Ministerial Regulation No. 126 cl.2(51) as amended by Ministerial Regulation No. 394 (B.E. 2567)
references.locator: Royal Gazette vol.141 pt.44 Kor p.13
references.quote: Severance under labour law is exempt up to the wages of the last 400 days and 600,000 baht, except on retirement or the end of a contract.

references.title: Revenue Department ruling Kor Kor 0702/760 of 28 January 2010, in the manual on income from leaving work
references.quote: Pay in lieu of notice is s.40(1) income joined with other income, not a s.48(5) lump sum; severance-style pay to an employee who resigned is not exempt.

name: Tax on severance filed apart (s.48(5))

references.title: Revenue Code s.48(5)
references.quote: Lump-sum pay on leaving may be taxed apart: 7,000 baht a year of service, then 50 percent of the rest, then the tax rates; 183 days of a part year count as a year.

references.title: Director-General of Revenue Notification on Income Tax No. 45 of 24 September 1992, as amended
references.quote: At least five years of service; income paid in the first tax year; other lump sums earn expenses up to the last month’s pay × years; withholding under s.50(1) follows the same method.

references.title: Revenue Department manual on income from leaving work (May 2012)
references.quote: Severance on retirement or the end of a contract is a clause 1(d) lump sum; the net income is not entitled to the 150,000 baht exemption.

name: Employee Welfare Fund (กองทุนสงเคราะห์ลูกจ้าง)

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) ss.126-131; Ministerial Regulation on Employee Welfare Fund rates B.E. 2568; Royal Decree on collection B.E. 2569
references.locator: LPA ss.130-131; MR B.E. 2568 cl.1, 3; Royal Decree B.E. 2569 ss.3-4
references.quote: Collection from 1 January 2027; employee and employer each 0.25 percent of wages.
